name: ncspot Keepalive
author: idrewlong
description: Keeps a Spotify TUI client session (ncspot or spotify-player, per ~/.config/omarchy-ncspot-arm/player) alive in the background via tmux, so Omarchy's built-in Media (MPRIS) bar widget can show now-playing and controls. Workaround for Spotify's official Linux client having no aarch64 build.

barWidget.description: Opens the configured Spotify TUI in a terminal, attaching the keepalive session
